name: Meta
loop: Trains V-JEPA 2, a self-supervised video world model pretrained on over 1M hours of internet video, then post-trained on under 62 hours of unlabeled robot video (V-JEPA 2-AC) to do zero-shot visual-goal planning for pick-and-place on Franka arms in unseen labs. Project Aria smart-glasses hardware plus Ego4D/Ego-Exo4D open datasets capture first-person human activity (hand pose, gaze, audio, 3D scene) at scale; academic groups (e.g. Georgia Tech's EgoMimic) then use this egocentric video to bootstrap robot manipulation policies with far less teleop data.
people: Yann LeCun (Chief AI Scientist, Meta FAIR)
note: One entry for Meta's two relevant programs: FAIR (V-JEPA world models, open weights) and Reality Labs (Project Aria glasses, Ego4D / Ego-Exo4D egocentric datasets). Pure research release from Meta FAIR; weights and code are open-sourced, but there is no commercial deployment arm — zero-shot lab tests on Franka arms in two labs are the only real-hardware evidence, not customer sites.
